subject: Request: onboarding credit & evidence waiver for HIPAA pilot
messages:
From: Carla Ortiz <carla.ortiz@carewell.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carewell.ai; legal@carewell.ai
Date: 2028-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: onboarding credit & evidence waiver for HIPAA pilot

Kimberly — thanks for the demo last week. Carewell is excited to kick off the 90-day pilot next Tuesday; we do have a couple of asks from procurement/legal before we sign the PO:

1) Onboarding credit: given this is a timeboxed pilot, procurement has asked if Redwood can provide a one-time onboarding/activation credit to offset the HSM activation + residency onboarding fee. Their ask is to offset ~50% of the activation line item.

2) Evidence waiver during pilot: legal is asking if we can defer some of the evidence delivery (detailed SOC2 artifacts and full HSM attestation) until pilot completion so we can start earlier. Carewell can provide limited ATO evidence but may not have the full vendor audit pack at contract signature.

3) HSM timing: we would like HSM activation deferred until production (pilot can use managed KMS). Is that possible without impacting the pilot feature set?

Can you confirm what you can do on credits/deferral and an itemized quote so procurement can start the PO? Happy to hop on a short call — I’ve cc’d procurement and legal.

Thanks,
Carla Ortiz
Director, Platform Partnerships
Carewell Health

Attachments: none (procurement asked to receive an itemized quote and any addenda to route to purchasing)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Carla Ortiz <carla.ortiz@carewell.ai>
Cc: procurement@carewell.ai; laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: onboarding credit & evidence waiver for HIPAA pilot

Hi Carla — great to hear the pilot is moving forward. We can be flexible to get you started quickly. High level response below and I can follow up with a formal addendum/quote once we align:

- One-time onboarding credit: we can offer a one-time credit equal to 50% of the onboarding activation fee, applied as a billing credit across the first three invoices (amortized).
- Evidence waiver: we can accept limited evidence to start (SOC2 summary + self-attestation) and phase delivery of the full vendor audit pack by the end of the pilot (90 days). We will require signed acceptance of the phased evidence schedule in the addendum.
- HSM activation: we can defer HSM until production; pilot will run with managed KMS and feature parity is maintained for configuration-based features. HSM activation can be added later with a 30-day lead time.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send an itemized quote with the one-time credit applied and an addendum that sequences evidence delivery.
2) If procurement approves the amortization over 3 invoices, we’ll provide a DocuSign addendum to sign.
3) We’ll queue HSM as deferred work in the SOW and attach the SOC2 evidence template for legal.

Attaching: SOC2_evidence_template.pdf and SOW_onboarding_draft.docx (drafts).

Can we set a brief call tomorrow 10a PT to confirm terms?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_template.pdf, SOW_onboarding_draft.docx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Carewell onboarding credit ask — finance/ops note

Kimberly / team — looped in to propose an operationally safe option that keeps the deal moving while limiting P&L impact:

- Offer a one-time onboarding credit (not a recurring discount) equal to 50% of the onboarding activation fee, but amortize the credit over 3 months (apply as invoice credits). This keeps revenue recognition straightforward and gives procurement what they want.
- Allow phased evidence delivery: accept SOC2 summary + self-attestation to start, require full evidence by pilot close. Legal addendum must explicitly state this and include remediation commitments.
- Defer HSM activation to production; ensure SOW notes the change and that HSM activation will require a separate billable activation (we can offer a promotional discount at that time tied to volume).

Finance impact estimate: the credit will reduce near-term recognized revenue by ~25% of the onboarding line in Q2; recommend exec approval for credits > $20k (if this hits that threshold).

If Kimberly confirms, I’ll draft the addendum and the itemized quote (include the amortization schedule).

— Aditya
Director, Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Carla Ortiz <carla.ortiz@carewell.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carewell.ai; legal@carewell.ai
Date: 2028-05-03T15:01:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: onboarding credit & evidence waiver for HIPAA pilot

Kimberly / Aditya — thanks for the quick response and flexibility. Procurement is amenable to the amortization over 3 invoices. A couple of clarifying asks before we sign:

- Can the evidence waiver explicitly limit full evidence delivery to 90 days from pilot start? We don’t want an open-ended deferment.
- During the pilot we request audit log retention at 30 days (we will evaluate going to 365 in production). Is that configurable?
- Please send the DocuSign addendum + an itemized quote (line items separated: onboarding activation, residency, auditlog retention, HSM seat) so procurement can raise a PO.

If you can get the addendum + itemized quote over today, procurement will try to turn the PO same day.

Thanks — Carla
Director, Platform Partnerships
Carewell Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Carla Ortiz <carla.ortiz@carewell.ai>
Cc: procurement@carewell.ai; laura.bennett@redwood.com; aditya.rao@redwood.com; dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-05T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: onboarding credit & evidence waiver for HIPAA pilot — final terms and next steps

Carla — thanks, we can confirm the following and will attach the formal documents for signature:

Final terms
- One-time onboarding credit: 50% of onboarding/activation fee = $25,000 credit. Applied as an invoice credit split equally across the first 3 invoices (amortized over 3 billing cycles).
- Evidence waiver: full SOC2 vendor pack required within 90 days of pilot start (pilot start = 2028-05-07). We will accept SOC2 summary + self-attestation at contract signature; addendum will document the phased delivery schedule and remediation commitments.
- HSM activation: deferred to production. Pilot will use managed KMS. HSM activation will be a separate billable activation; we will provide a promotional activation discount at production if you commit within 6 months of pilot close.
- Audit log retention during pilot: configurable to 30 days. Production default is 365 days; we can configure per environment and will note the pilot retention in the SOW.

Attachments we are sending now:
- itemized_quote_Carewell_0528.xlsx (line-item breakdown + amortization schedule)
- docusign_addendum_link.txt (DocuSign link to sign the evidence addendum + credit terms)
- SOW_onboarding_draft.docx (updated to reflect deferred HSM and pilot retention)
- SOC2_evidence_template.pdf

Next steps (action owners)
- Kimberly: send DocuSign link and itemized quote (done).
- Carla / Carewell procurement: review and return PO referencing the DocuSign addendum.
- Aditya / Finance: once DocuSign signed, apply credit schedule in billing system.
- Dev / Solutions: schedule kickoff for pilot on 2028-05-07.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you started.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: itemized_quote_Carewell_0528.xlsx, docusign_addendum_link.txt, SOW_onboarding_draft.docx, SOC2_evidence_template.pdf
